bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea at Bromley Court Hotel. The Garden Restaurant features the perfect interior, with natural light through the conservatory windows, and idyllic views of the garden.  The hotel is in a historic location, and was the family home of Charles Long, 1st Baron Farnborough. It has been a family owned hotel since 1931. The Garden Restaurant is within the hotel's stunning gardens, offering up Afternoon Tea with a view.  Afternoon Tea is served in the conservatory. This is a beautifully lit space, with natural light creating a warm, bright atmosphere. There is also access to the garden, so guests can enjoy a pre or post Afternoon Tea walk.  The menu features a traditional Afternoon Tea, including a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, and freshly baked scones with clotted cream and seasonal preserves. To finish it off, there are a selection of indulgent sweet treats, such as the caramel éclair with craquelin. Afternoon Tea is also served with a range of teas and infusions. Guests desiring an extra sense of luxury can upgrade to the Sparkling Afternoon Tea, which includes a glass of Prosecco.  Bromley Court Hotel is located in Bromley, near Bromley North and South station, as well as Ravensbourne station.
